answer: One identity posts one bond, capped at 400 POA per epoch. The cap does the work: 1,000 clones lock 400,000 POA to earn what 1,000 honest ravens earn, while one honest agent locks 400. Break-even needs a 71% pass rate against juries that reject duplicates, and farms here sit near 12%, so the ember detection contract pays them nothing while it pays an honest node 400. Collateral sits in the jetty contract for 6 epochs, which is 2,400 POA of float per clone.
